findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "اكتب رسالتك هنا..." is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-bottom-right-radius: 18px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
